ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central lobe areas and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupying the center of both lobes. Distinct dark pixel blobs mapped to the outer-upper right lobe (large circular spot) and multiple smaller dark focal clusters scattered along the medial and trailing edges of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending deep into the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map. The trailing edge displays a continuous sequence of jagged peaks and valleys from the median notch to the lateral tips, particularly pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, resulting in an upward-sweeping, tapered geometry ending in sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several high-contrast dark circular clusters; most prominent is a large, isolated circular mark on the distal quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, thin linear pixel disruption identified on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the center toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and micro-notches along the trailing edge indicating environmental wear or past minor trauma; prominent focal dark spot on the right lobe distal edge.
